_comment: Drop these snippets into each client's MCP config to connect Nexus skills (browser automation, DevTools, campaign planning, video render, Telegram) to any agent host.

nexus.description: Nexus digital-marketer skill set: content, ads planning, browser automation, DevTools, rendering, Telegram control

playwright.description: Optional: microsoft/playwright-mcp for richer DOM/CDP control inside Antigravity

lm_studio_hermes._how: LM Studio → Installed → MCP Servers → Add: command python3, args [ABSOLUTE_PATH/agent/nexus_mcp.py]. Hermes tool-calling will discover the 13 Nexus tools automatically.

xai_grok_agentic._note: Grok does not yet accept stdio MCP servers directly; expose nexus_mcp over an SSE gateway (e.g. supergateway: npx -y supergateway --stdio "python3 agent/nexus_mcp.py" --port 8957) and register the URL in clients that support remote MCP.

hermes_agent_nexus_tasks._how: ~/.hermes/config.yaml → mcp_servers (YAML). Safe server: only creates pending_approval tasks. Copy skills/nexus to ~/.hermes/skills/marketing/nexus.

lm_studio_nexus_tasks._how: ~/.lmstudio/mcp.json (Windows %USERPROFILE%\.lmstudio\mcp.json). Safe task-only tools for unattended local models.
